identityPolicy.statement: Every phase retains the observed file/title set; the current union is evidence, not a permanent ten-suite identity.

freshIsolated.durationInterpretation: median duration is for each whole-file process, not a per-test timeout measurement

classificationFacts.sandboxEnvironmentBoundary: spawn EPERM before Vitest discovery; retained as separate environment/runner lineage
classificationFacts.noResourceLeakClassificationReason: process, heap, and actual worker-count correlation are unavailable

classificationBoundaries.boundary: normal process completion with assertion evidence and no timeout/watchdog signal
explicit Vitest timeout output with completed or complete timeout evidence
missing completion or owned process requiring external watchdog cleanup
fresh pass plus repeated group failure with comparable process/heap/worker correlation
unchanged local run differs with host/process environment evidence

hypotheses.falsificationTest: Compare two normal/default group observations with the same 23-file order against two same-file single-worker observations, while contrasting the 230 fresh per-file passes.
observations: DefaultGroup has mixed timeout/assertion failures twice while SingleWorkerGroup passes twice.
FreshIsolated passes all 230 fresh processes while grouped default remains mixed.
hypotheses.consequence: Highest current hypothesis and diagnosis signal only; do not change worker or configuration and do not call SingleWorkerGroup a fix.

hypotheses.falsificationTest: Repeat every observed file in a fresh owned process ten times and compare grouped failure identities.
observations: 230/230 fresh records pass with no timeout, assertion, or watchdog classification.
Single-worker group also passes twice without source changes.
hypotheses.consequence: No test-local lifecycle or cleanup repair gate is unlocked.

hypotheses.falsificationTest: Change only isolate, order, or pool in a separate comparable branch while preserving files and command.
observations: Fresh isolation and group worker comparison do not isolate order/isolation/pool as a single variable.
hypotheses.consequence: Stop before opening OneVariable isolate/order/pool branches; record blocked/no-code decision.

hypotheses.falsificationTest: Require repeated same-file assertion/title/message without timeout or worker-hang signal in fresh processes.
observations: Three assertions appear only in the mixed NormalFull run and two assertions recur only in DefaultGroup; fresh and single-worker records have no assertions.
hypotheses.consequence: Do not create characterization RED or modify an evidence-selected test.

hypotheses.falsificationTest: Compare unchanged normal settings after environment capture and distinguish sandbox process-start failure from normal Vitest output.
observations: Sandbox spawn EPERM occurs before Vitest discovery and is retained as a separate boundary.
Normal environment reaches Vitest and still reproduces worker-sensitive grouped failures.
hypotheses.consequence: Environment explains the sandbox attempt only, not the normal baseline root cause; no environment workaround is authorized.

oneVariableBranch.reason: No isolate/order/pool/lifecycle branch is falsifiable from the available comparable evidence, and resource correlation is unavailable.

repairGate.reason: Current evidence supports only a worker-sensitive diagnosis signal; it does not prove a test-local defect and required direct resource metrics are unavailable.
repairGate.nextTasksBranch: 5.1/5.2/5.3 must use blocked/no-code/N/A evidence and make no source repair

risks: Single-worker passes are diagnostic observations, not a product fix.
Unknown mixed classifications remain blocked because assertion and timeout signals coexist.
Failure identity drifts across NormalFull runs; no fixed suite identity is assumed.
No direct process, heap, or actual worker-count measurements are available.
